# Sound It Out

> Printable PDF worksheets for children aged 3 to 8 (preschool, kindergarten and first grade): phonics and decodable reading, sight words, alphabet tracing, numbers, addition and subtraction. Every pack comes in full color and in black and white, in US Letter and A4. Free sample pages can be downloaded without signing up.

## Free
- [All free worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-printable-worksheets/): free sample pages from every pack, plus a free reading app
- [Free reading app](https://sounditoutreading.com/app/): reading games in the browser where every word can be sounded out
- [Free Blending Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-blending-game/): You say the sounds slowly, your child says the whole word. No letters to look at, so it trains the ear first.
- [Free Word Building Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-word-building-game/): Your child hears a word and taps the letter tiles in the right order to build it.
- [Free CVC Word Reading Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-cvc-word-reading-game/): One short word at a time, such as sat, pin or dog. Every word uses only the sounds of the level you choose.
- [Free Word Chains Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-word-chains-game/): One sound changes each time: map, mad, mud. Your child spots what changed and reads the new word.
- [Free Sentence Reading Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-sentence-reading-game/): One short sentence at a time, built only from words your child can sound out.
- [Free Decodable Story Game](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-decodable-story-game/): Five sentences about one person, one sentence at a time. Real reading, with every word decodable.
- [Free Alphabet Tracing Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-alphabet-tracing-worksheets/): 3 free printable pages. A to Z letter tracing worksheets with beginning sounds
- [Free Numbers 1 to 20 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-number-tracing-and-counting-1-to-20/): 3 free printable pages. Number tracing and counting worksheets with ten frames
- [Free Addition to 10 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-addition-within-10-worksheets/): 3 free printable pages. Addition within 10 worksheets with pictures and a number line
- [Free Subtraction to 10 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-subtraction-within-10-worksheets/): 3 free printable pages. Subtraction within 10 worksheets with cross-out pictures and a number line
- [Free Addition to 5 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-addition-to-5/): 3 free printable pages. Addition within 5 worksheets with pictures and a number line
- [Free Sight Words Set 1 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-sight-words-set-1/): 3 free printable pages. Sight word practice worksheets, one word per page
- [Free Subtraction to 5 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-subtraction-to-5/): 3 free printable pages. Subtraction within 5 worksheets with pictures and a number line
- [Free Addition to 20 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-addition-to-20/): 3 free printable pages. Addition within 20 worksheets with a number line
- [Free Sight Words Set 2 Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-sight-words-set-2/): 3 free printable pages. Sight word practice worksheets, one word per page
- [Free Short A Words Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-short-vowel-a-words/): 3 free printable pages. Short a words worksheets, CVC word family practice
- [Free CVC Cut and Paste Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/free-cvc-cut-and-paste/): 3 free printable pages. CVC cut and paste worksheets for beginning, middle and ending sounds

## Guides
- [My Child Does Not Understand Subtraction: What to Do](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-my-child-does-not-understand-subtraction/): Learn why subtraction confuses many young children and try four simple activities this week to build real number sense at home.
- [My Child Reads Slowly, One Sound at a Time: What to Do](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-child-reads-slowly-one-sound-at-a-time/): Learn why your child reads one sound at a time instead of smoothly, and the exact steps to build speed and confidence this week.
- [What Is a Sight Word?](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-what-is-a-sight-word/): Learn exactly what a sight word is, why these words break phonics rules, and the simple steps to teach your child to recognize them fast.
- [When Should a Child Know All Their Letters?](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-when-should-a-child-know-all-letters/): Learn the typical age range for learning all 26 letters, uppercase and lowercase, and what to do if your child needs more practice.
- [How to Teach a Child to Hold a Pencil](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-how-to-teach-pencil-grip/): See what age children are ready to learn a proper pencil grip, with easy activities that build hand strength for handwriting.
- [How to Teach a Child to Tell Time](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-how-to-teach-a-child-to-tell-time/): Find out when children usually learn to tell time, and get simple steps for teaching whole hours, half hours, and minutes on a clock.
- [My Child Knows Sounds but Cannot Blend: What to Do](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-my-child-knows-sounds-but-cannot-blend/): Your child knows the letter sounds but cannot blend them into words. Learn why this happens and four things to try this week.
- [My Child Mixes Up B and D: What to Do](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-my-child-mixes-up-b-and-d/): Your child's b and d confusion is common and short term. Learn why it happens and four simple things to try at home this week.
- [What Age Can a Child Cut Shapes and Glue Accurately](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-cutting-and-gluing-skills-by-age/): Learn the age range when children usually learn to cut simple shapes and glue accurately, and how to help build these skills.
- [When Should a Child Learn to Count to 100?](https://sounditoutreading.com/guide-when-do-kids-count-to-100/): Learn when children typically count to 100, and simple ways to help your child master counting by tens and ones at home.

## Categories
- [Addition Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/addition-worksheets/): 3 printable packs
- [Subtraction Worksheets](https://sounditoutreading.com/subtraction-worksheets/): 2 printable packs
- [Learn to Read](https://sounditoutreading.com/learn-to-read-printables/): Printable phonics and decodable reading practice for kindergarten and first grade, where every word can be sounded out.
- [Sight Words](https://sounditoutreading.com/sight-words-worksheets/): Printable sight word worksheets for kindergarten and first grade: read, trace, write, find and build each word.
- [Alphabet and Handwriting](https://sounditoutreading.com/alphabet-and-handwriting-worksheets/): Printable alphabet tracing, letter formation and handwriting worksheets for preschool and kindergarten, from A to Z.
- [Numbers and Counting](https://sounditoutreading.com/numbers-and-counting-worksheets/): Printable number tracing, counting and number sense worksheets for preschool and kindergarten, with ten frames and number lines.
- [Addition and Subtraction](https://sounditoutreading.com/addition-and-subtraction-worksheets/): Printable addition and subtraction worksheets for preschool, kindergarten and first grade, with pictures, number lines and answer keys.
